Privacy settings
Your place is needed
The map needs the approximate place of your phone. Only a field leaves your phone, never your position.
Before you start

Your friends see a field on a grid while you are active, and you see theirs. Nobody else sees it. The field is sent in private messages that disappear after three minutes. Nothing is kept, there is no history, and there is no map picture, so no map server learns where you look.
Your field is about 1 km wide. You can change that in the privacy settings.

What is public
Your profile, your discovery card with a field of about 5 km while it is visible, and your posts and stories. Your presence on the map, your chats, your likes and your blocks are private.
